About Me

I'm Abdallah Mohamed, a Frontend Developer based in Alexandria with a passion for building web experiences that look as good as they perform. I believe that great design and clean code aren't mutually exclusive — they amplify each other.

As a freelancer, I've delivered complete websites end-to-end — from pixel-perfect layouts to interactive features. My work covers landing pages, business sites, and full web platforms built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

I obsess over the details: smooth animations, responsive grids, fast load times, and interfaces that feel natural to use. Every project I ship is something I'm proud to put my name on.
